title: הציפור שלימדה רכבת שלמה להיות שקטה
summary: How a kingfisher's beak solved the Shinkansen tunnel boom: a fast train in a tunnel is a piston, the compression wave runs ahead at the speed of sound (340 m/s vs 83 m/s) and bursts out of the far portal; boom ~ v³; JR West engineer Eiji Nakatsu (a birdwatcher) asked which creature copes with a sudden change in resistance, fired bullet shapes into a pipe, and gave the 500 Series (1997, 300 km/h) a 15 m beak-shaped nose: 30% less pressure, 10% faster, 15% less electricity; owl-feather serrations on the pantograph; the common kingfisher passes through Israel in autumn, its Hebrew name coined by Bialik.
reviewer_verdict: PASS (2 rounds) — nits left: reviewer estimates ~45–60 min vs the 30-min tag (same word counts as #19); kingfisher weight sources disagree (page says ~40 g, Israeli sources 19–26 g); Arto FAB can overlap a canvas label at the viewport bottom (series layout)
